title: Canon of the Ruinous Gale
summary: A canon of wind arts that rise from the qi field to the ruin of a gale that no wall and no host can stand against.

title: The Hurricane Core Manual
summary: A manual of the hurricane held in the formed core and loosed as typhoons that lay waste to whatever the student turns upon.

title: Treatise of the Divine Tempest
summary: A treatise on the tempest of divine energy that scours the sky and ground alike and ends in a ruin fit for the heavens.
